name: Charles Beauchamp
source:
Animal Type: Eastern Gray Squirrel
Hometown: Chicago, Illinois, United States

Refined and observant. Although he has an impressive investment portfolio and plenty of savings, he still chooses to continue his career to supplement his income so that he may retire early. Really early. That's so he may spend more time with his extended family, which he hasn't done often. Perhaps that includes friends, as well?!
